description: Convert a table from CSV, TSV or JSON into CSV, TSV, JSON (array of objects) or a Markdown table. Cell values are kept as text. Use when the user wants the same table in another format. Do NOT use to trim, dedupe or drop rows; use clean_table.

data.description: The whole table as text, first row = header. CSV/TSV text (quoted cells allowed), or a JSON array of flat objects, e.g. "name,age\nAsha,30".

from_format.description: Format of the input 'data': csv, tsv or json.

to_format.description: Output format: csv, tsv, json (array of objects keyed by header) or markdown (pipe table).

name: convert_table

columns.description: Number of columns in the header row.

rows.description: Number of data rows (excluding the header).

text.description: The converted table as text in to_format.

title: Convert table
